name: this website
summary: the grid-paper portfolio you are reading. black, white, and a lot of springs.
problem: Present my projects, skills, and credentials in a portfolio that feels like an engineer's notebook, with enough detail for a recruiter or collaborator to explore the work.
highlights: Data-driven projects: Shared project data powers the project list, detail pages, technology chips, and credentials toolbox.
Notebook presentation: A grid-paper background, expressive typography, and brand-colored icons carry across responsive light and dark layouts.
Inspectable evidence: Project source links, an aaaflow media showcase, and permanently redacted certificate PDFs provide supporting material.

media.caption: The live portfolio homepage before the gallery update.
The project index before screenshot thumbnails were added.

sections.heading: The workflow
sections.body:
- Browse featured work on the homepage.
- Open a project to read its workflow and implementation.
- Explore source code or available demos.
- Review credentials and contact details.

sections.heading: Under the hood
sections.body: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS provide the site structure. Motion handles animation, reduced-motion preferences are supported, and GitHub pushes trigger Vercel deployment.

sections.heading: Scope & current state
sections.body: This is the portfolio itself. Project demonstrations are linked where available; the site does not run the local AI applications on the visitor's device.
